brief:
The UN is continuing efforts to support Palestinians in Gaza despite major obstacles to humanitarian access, reconstruction, and essential services, according to Ramiz Alakbarov, Acting UN Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process. Alakbarov characterized Palestinian aspirations as centered on achieving "a return to normal life."

The UN's work in Gaza faces significant constraints as the territory grapples with challenges across multiple sectors including humanitarian delivery, infrastructure rebuilding, and the restoration of basic services.

title: UN envoy says Palestinians seek return to normal life in Gaza
